title: Write a 5-Minute Cold Email Pitch with ChatGPT & Zapier
excerpt: Learn how to write a cold email in under five minutes using ChatGPT, then automate sending and tracking with Zapier. A step‑by‑step guide that saves you time and boosts outreach efficiency.
metaDescription: Discover a quick workflow that uses ChatGPT to draft a personalized cold email in seconds, then Zapier to send it automatically and track opens with Mailtr
author: Ali Hamza
body:
Are you still spending 30 minutes drafting a cold email every time you pitch a new client? Imagine slashing that to just 5 minutes. In this quick guide, I’ll walk you through a proven workflow that combines ChatGPT’s creative power with Zapier’s automation to write, send, and track a killer cold email in under five minutes.

Step 1 - Craft the Email with ChatGPT

Open ChatGPT and start a new conversation. Paste the following prompt:

> “Write a concise, personalized cold email for a [industry] prospect named [Name] who works at [Company]. The email should highlight a pain point, propose a quick 15‑minute call, and close with a friendly sign‑off. Keep it under 120 words.”

Feel free to tweak the placeholders to match your target. Once ChatGPT returns the draft, copy the text. The AI will give you a polished, ready‑to‑send email that feels personal and professional.

Step 2 - Keep Formatting in Gmail

Paste the email into a new Gmail draft. To preserve line breaks and formatting, use “Paste without formatting” (Ctrl+Shift+V on Windows or Cmd+Shift+V on Mac). Add a compelling subject line such as “Quick win for [Company] in 15 minutes”. Hit “Save draft” and you’re ready to send.

Step 3 - Automate with Zapier

1. **Trigger** - Create a new Google Sheet with columns: Recipient Email, Subject, Body. Whenever you paste a new row, Zapier will fire.
2. **Action 1** - Gmail: Use the “Send Email” action. Map the sheet columns to the email fields. This sends the email automatically.
3. **Action 2** - Mailtrack: Add a “Track Email” action to log open rates. Mailtrack’s webhook will record whether the recipient opens the email.

You can also add a delay step if you want to send emails in batches, or a filter to skip rows where the email address is blank.

Step 4 - Review and Iterate

After the first batch, check the Mailtrack logs to see open rates. If a particular subject line or opener isn’t performing, tweak the prompt in ChatGPT and update the sheet. Because the workflow is automated, you can iterate quickly without re‑entering data manually.

Why This Works - **Speed**: ChatGPT writes a high‑quality email in seconds, eliminating the 30‑minute drafting loop. - **Consistency**: The template ensures every email follows a proven structure - pain point, solution, CTA, sign‑off. - **Automation**: Zapier handles sending and tracking, freeing you to focus on follow‑ups and strategy.

Ready to try it? Grab a coffee, open ChatGPT, and start drafting. With this setup, you’ll spend less than 5 minutes on each new outreach and more time closing deals.
